notes.title: Ship, Inc. v1.0.9 - Enhancements & Rare Bugs Update (Fixes & Improvements)
notes.content:
More polish, more fixes, and some long-requested tweaks! Here’s what’s been updated in version 1.0.9:


🛠️ Gameplay & Systems
🏷️ HomeDIY now properly shows Chemical Stickers when using category buttons (not just drag & drop)


📦 Completed orders bug fixed – no more getting softlocked when sending another box to the same address


🔁 “Restock All” button added to HomeDIY! From Day 5 onward, restock all stickers and boxes with one click


💥 Auto Order Shredder upgrade fix attempt – couldn’t fully repro, but updated logic to (hopefully) fix it 🤞




🔊 Visual & Audio Fixes
🧻 Bubble Wrap sprite fix – no longer flipped on Toilet orders


🔊 Wrapping sound loop bug patched – rare bug where it played forever should now be silenced if item not held


🔋 Penlight battery visual fix – no more floating battery moment on the conveyor belt




📄 UI & Mini-Game Tweaks
📜 Long item names fix – text should now fit better on the paper thanks to scale tweaks


🧼 Cleaning mini-game updated – made dirt slightly fewer and area slightly smaller for better visibility


📦 Collider edge-case resolved – overlapping mini colliders + outer collider bug that caused parent issues is now handled



Thanks again for all the reports and chaos-filled videos. Keep ‘em coming – we're watching closely and tweaking daily! 🚀🐈

notes.title: Ship, Inc. v1.0.7 - Bug Fixes Update!
notes.content:
Hey Shippers!

We are back for a few more minor fixes and adjustments for start of this week! This one touches on stickers, saves, and a whole lotta tape 🎉

🎮 Gameplay Changes & Fixes

✂️ Cutting the tape now removes all remaining stickers on the box – no more sticker confusion!
💳 Direct Cheque logic updated – now sends all money above $1000 (not just income), leaving you with exactly $1000
💊 Huge Pharma's item pool updated – now starts with 5 Level 1 items instead of just 1, making leveling up smoother
📉 Game Over trigger tweaked – now triggers if you have more than 3 unpaid items at the end of the day (not 3 or more)


🛠️ Technical & Save System Updates

💾 Removed OnApplicationQuit auto-saving – sudden quits won’t silently override your save anymore
🚚 Added more control to Truck Area collisions – boxes now reset as soon as they touch stage colliders, preventing weird pushes
📁 Save/Load system overhauled! This might finally squash all remaining save bugs (fingers crossed)


If you are still having save issues, please contact us on our Discord or Steam Community Forums. 

Thanks for reporting everything so thoroughly – keep it coming, and we’ll keep patching! 📦🐈

---

notes.title: v0.8.0 - Demo Patch Notes (Bank & Tutorial Update) 🏦🚚
notes.content:
The trucks have backed in, and the latest patch is here! We've introduced a brand-new Banking System, polished the tutorial experience, and made a whole bunch of UI and gameplay improvements based on your feedback. Here's what's new in this delivery:

💰 New: Bank System!  
- You can now access the Bank Area from your map.  
- Daily Bonus: Earn 1% interest on your deposited amount every day.  
- Functional Bank UI and templates are in place—deposit, withdraw, and watch your balance grow.  
- Updated Bank Area sprite + added cloud visuals to all map areas.

- Cleaner and shorter tutorial text for a smoother onboarding.  
- Tutorial Post-Its now appear pinned to the corkboard.  
- Added a clickable tutorial link in the settings menu.  
- Added a 2-second click delay to avoid accidental skips.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537976/bae488483949dfaff6f1c9506686bc1d8a7210a4.png

📦 Visual & UI Updates  
- Improved box visuals on the upgrade screen.  
- Box flap animations refined (no more floppy boxes).  
- Incoming box visual improvements.  
- New sliced warning panel with a rounded design.  
- Map area now shows/hides left/right navigation buttons based on your position.  
- Enhanced map top indicator for better orientation.  
- Better Japanese/Korean text fitting (adjusted sizes + overflow fixes).  
- Tablet UI now scrolls to top when opened.  
- New tablet hover text behavior for better UX.  
- Address entry now supports keyboard input.

🧹 Misc. Fixes & Enhancements  
- Excess item bug fixed (again!).  
- Fixed non-showing item issues in some orders.  
- Improved item box collider layers and interactions.  
- Softer red tone for house payment notices.  
- "Buy a Lucky Bubble Wrap Pop Game" & "Come back in the morning" mechanics added.  
- Drink hovering visuals on the desk improved.  
- OrderPages now maintain better image order.  
- "Post-it" index control cleanup.  
- Syncer improvements across UI configs.


As always, thank you for packing, stacking, and shipping with us. More polish and upgrades are coming soon! 💼📦
